content.caption:
The Developer Roadmap 💻
Comment “ROADMAP”, and I’ll send you the link to full details!

Whether you’re just starting with HTML and CSS or you’re diving into LLM integration and Vector DBs, understanding these roles is key to navigating the tech industry. 

The path evolves as you stack your skills:

Frontend Dev: Master the basics with HTML, CSS, JS, React, and Git.

Backend Dev: Focus on the logic with JS/Python, MongoDB/SQL, and APIs.

Software Dev: Combine Frontend and Backend with System Design.

Full Stack Dev: Take your software development to the next level with Deployment.

AI Developer: Bridge the gap with Prompting and LLM Integration.

AI Engineer: The peak of the stack, incorporating RAG, Vector DB, LangChain, and Cloud.

Which level are you currently on? 👇

Whatever your goal, keep building and keep learning. The tech stack never stops evolving!

Comment “ROADMAP”, and I’ll send you the link to full details!
